title: Session expires on page reload
description: Users are being logged out unexpectedly whenever they reload the page. The session token appears to be invalidated on each page load even within the session timeout window. Reproduces consistently in Chrome and Firefox.

title: Login fails after token refresh
description: After the access token is refreshed using the refresh token endpoint, subsequent API calls return 401 Unauthorized. The user must log in again manually. This breaks long-running sessions and causes data loss in multi-step workflows.

title: Password reset email is delayed
description: Users report that password reset emails are arriving 15–45 minutes after the request is made. The delay is inconsistent and appears to be related to the email delivery queue under high load.

title: Application logs out after browser refresh
description: The application signs the user out every time the browser page is refreshed with F5 or Ctrl+R. Session persistence across page reloads is broken. Users lose unsaved work as a result.

title: Authentication breaks when renewing access token
description: When the client attempts to silently renew the access token via the refresh token grant, the new token is rejected by the resource server with HTTP 401. Clearing cookies and re-authenticating temporarily resolves the issue.

title: MFA prompt not shown for high-risk logins
description: Users logging in from unrecognized devices or IP addresses are not prompted for multi-factor authentication as expected by the security policy. This creates a security gap for accounts with MFA enabled.

title: Remember me cookie does not persist across browser restarts
description: When users select 'Remember me' at login, the persistent session cookie is not set correctly and expires when the browser is closed. Users must log in again on every browser restart.

title: OAuth2 callback URL mismatch on staging environment
description: The OAuth2 authorization code flow fails on the staging environment because the registered redirect URI does not match the callback URL returned by the identity provider. Results in error: redirect_uri_mismatch.
resolution: Updated the redirect URI in the OAuth application settings to include the staging hostname.

title: User session lost when navigating back using browser history
description: Clicking the browser back button causes the session to terminate and redirects the user to the login page. This is intermittent and happens more frequently after long periods of inactivity.

title: Account locked out after single failed login attempt
description: The account lockout policy is incorrectly triggering after just one failed login attempt instead of the configured five attempts. Users are being locked out due to typos and must contact support to regain access.

title: Search page crashes on empty query
description: Submitting the search form with an empty input field causes the search service to throw an unhandled NullPointerException. The page displays a 500 Internal Server Error instead of a helpful validation message.

title: Search results load slowly for large projects
description: Searching within projects containing more than 10,000 issues takes over 30 seconds to return results. The query is not using the indexed fields and performs a full table scan on the database.

title: Search filter by date range returns no results
description: Applying a date range filter in the advanced search panel results in zero items returned even when matching records exist. The filter appears to compare timestamps with incorrect timezone offsets.

title: Wildcard search returns duplicate entries in results list
description: Using a wildcard character (*) in the search query causes the same issue to appear multiple times in the result list. This is caused by incorrect deduplication logic in the result aggregation step.

title: Null pointer exception when search form submitted without input
description: When the user clicks the search button without entering any text in the search box, the backend throws java.lang.NullPointerException at SearchController.java:47. The application returns a generic 500 error page with no user guidance.

title: Search index not updated after bulk issue import
description: After importing issues in bulk via the API, the search index is not refreshed. Newly imported issues do not appear in search results for up to 1 hour until the scheduled index refresh job runs.

title: Boolean search operators AND/OR are ignored
description: Queries using explicit Boolean operators such as 'login AND token' or 'crash OR timeout' are treated as plain keyword searches. The results do not respect the operator logic, returning irrelevant results.

title: Search autocomplete suggestions are stale
description: The autocomplete dropdown in the search bar shows outdated suggestions based on a cached index that is not invalidated when new projects or issues are created. New project names never appear in suggestions.
resolution: Implemented cache invalidation on project creation and updated autocomplete refresh interval to 5 minutes.

title: Search times out for queries with special characters
description: Queries containing special characters such as parentheses, hyphens, or quotes cause the search engine to enter an infinite loop, resulting in a 30-second timeout and a degraded experience for all users on the cluster.

title: Search result ranking is inconsistent across page refreshes
description: Refreshing the same search query returns results in a different order each time. The ranking algorithm has a non-deterministic tie-breaking step that produces unstable result ordering, confusing users.

title: Dark mode toggle reverts to light mode after navigation
description: When a user switches to dark mode and then navigates to a different page, the theme preference is lost and the UI reverts to light mode. The preference is not persisted in localStorage or user settings.

title: Tooltip text overflows container on small screens
description: Tooltips on action buttons overflow the viewport boundaries on screens narrower than 768px. The text is clipped or extends off-screen, rendering the tooltip content unreadable on tablet and mobile devices.
resolution: Applied max-width and text-overflow CSS styles to tooltip component and added responsive breakpoint handling.

title: Modal dialog does not close when clicking outside
description: Clicking outside the bounds of a modal dialog no longer dismisses it. Users must click the explicit close button or press Escape. This regression was introduced in the v2.4 UI library upgrade.

title: Dropdown menu items not accessible via keyboard navigation
description: Dropdown menus in the header cannot be navigated using the Tab or Arrow keys. Screen reader users and keyboard-only users are unable to access menu items, causing an accessibility violation under WCAG 2.1 AA.

title: Loading spinner blocks user interaction indefinitely on timeout
description: If an API call times out, the loading spinner remains visible and blocks all UI interactions. There is no timeout fallback to dismiss the spinner and display an error message to the user.

title: Table column widths reset when sorting is applied
description: Custom column widths set by the user via drag-resize are discarded whenever the user clicks a column header to sort. The table reverts to default column widths after each sort action.

title: Form validation errors not announced to screen readers
description: When a form is submitted with invalid data, the error messages are displayed visually but are not announced by ARIA live regions. Screen reader users receive no feedback about which fields have errors.

title: Pagination component skips page numbers above 100
description: In the paginated list view, the page number input field does not accept values above 100 due to a hardcoded max attribute. Users with more than 100 pages of results cannot navigate to later pages.
resolution: Removed hardcoded max attribute and replaced with dynamically calculated total page count from the API response.

title: Chart renders with incorrect colors in high-contrast mode
description: When the operating system or browser is set to high-contrast mode, the chart component renders all data series in black, making it impossible to distinguish between different data sets.

title: Breadcrumb trail shows incorrect path after direct URL navigation
description: When a user navigates directly to a deep link URL, the breadcrumb component displays an incorrect path. It shows the root item only instead of the full hierarchy, breaking navigation context.

title: Permission check allows viewer to edit settings
description: Users with the 'Viewer' role are able to access and submit the project settings form. The backend permission check for the settings endpoint is missing the role validation step, allowing unauthorized modifications.

title: Deleted user retains API access via existing tokens
description: When a user account is deleted, their previously issued API tokens remain valid and continue to grant access to protected resources. Token revocation is not triggered on account deletion.

title: Role assignment API does not validate target role exists
description: The endpoint for assigning roles to users does not verify that the specified role ID exists in the system. Assigning a non-existent role ID silently succeeds and leaves the user with no valid permissions.

title: Viewer role user can modify project settings via API
description: A user with a 'Viewer' role can bypass the UI restrictions and call the PATCH /api/projects/{id}/settings endpoint directly, successfully modifying settings. The API layer is not enforcing role-based access controls.

title: Permission inheritance does not cascade to sub-projects
description: When a role is assigned at the parent project level, the permissions do not cascade to sub-projects as documented. Users must have their roles re-assigned manually for each sub-project.

title: Audit log does not record permission changes
description: Changes to user roles and permissions are not being recorded in the audit log. Security teams are unable to track who made permission changes and when, which is a compliance requirement.

title: Group membership changes do not take effect until next login
description: When a user is added to or removed from a security group, the permission changes do not apply to their current session. The user must log out and log back in for the new group membership to take effect.

title: API key with read-only scope can write data
description: API keys created with a read-only scope are incorrectly able to perform write operations such as creating and updating records. The scope enforcement middleware is not being applied to all API routes.

title: Cross-tenant data access possible due to missing tenancy filter
description: In multi-tenant deployments, the data access layer is missing a tenancy filter on several ORM queries. This allows users from Tenant A to retrieve data belonging to Tenant B by manipulating resource IDs in request URLs.

title: 403 Forbidden returned when accessing own user profile
description: Authenticated users receive a 403 Forbidden error when attempting to view their own user profile page. The permission check is incorrectly evaluating against admin-only policy instead of the self-access policy.
resolution: Fixed permission policy evaluation order to check self-access policy before admin policy for profile endpoints.

title: CSV export omits records
description: When exporting a report to CSV, records from pages beyond the first page of results are omitted. The export function only processes the first page of the paginated result set, truncating the output for large datasets.
resolution: Fixed export service to iterate through all pages of the result set before writing to CSV.

title: Report generation fails with memory error for large date ranges
description: Generating a report covering more than 90 days of data causes an OutOfMemoryError on the report server. The report service loads all records into memory at once instead of streaming them to the output file.

title: Scheduled report emails are sent with empty attachments
description: Automated scheduled reports are sent to subscribers with a PDF attachment, but the PDF file is empty (0 bytes). The report generation job completes without errors, but the output file is not being properly attached.

title: Custom report templates are overwritten on system upgrade
description: After upgrading to the latest application version, all user-defined custom report templates are deleted and replaced with the default templates. The upgrade script is not preserving the custom template directory.

title: Downloaded spreadsheet missing rows from paginated results
description: The Excel file downloaded from the report page is missing data rows. Investigation shows that only the currently visible page of results is included in the export. Records on subsequent pages are not included in the downloaded file.
resolution: Identified as duplicate of REP-501. The same pagination fix resolves this issue.

title: Report filter by assignee does not include unassigned issues
description: When filtering a report by a specific assignee, selecting 'Unassigned' from the dropdown returns zero results even when there are many issues with no assignee. The filter query is not handling the null assignee case.

title: Time tracking summary report shows negative hours
description: The weekly time tracking summary report displays negative hour values for some users. This is caused by a timezone conversion error where end times on Sunday are calculated relative to Monday of the following week.

title: PDF report fonts are missing on Linux server
description: PDF reports generated on the Linux production server use fallback fonts because the required font files are not installed. The resulting PDFs have inconsistent typography and some characters are rendered as boxes.
resolution: Installed required font packages on the production server and added font availability check to the deployment checklist.

title: Report sharing link expires prematurely
description: Shareable report links are expiring after 1 hour instead of the configured 7-day TTL. The link expiration value is being read from an environment variable that is not set in the production environment.

title: Trend chart in report dashboard shows all-zero values
description: The trend analysis chart on the main reporting dashboard renders with all values at zero after the latest deployment. The chart data endpoint returns valid data but the chart component is not mapping the response fields correctly.

title: Database connection pool exhausted under peak load
description: During peak usage hours, the application runs out of available database connections, causing requests to queue and eventually time out. The connection pool maximum size is set too low for the current traffic volume.

title: Slow query on issues table missing composite index
description: The query to fetch all open issues for a user filtered by project and status performs a sequential scan because the composite index on (project_id, status, assignee_id) is missing. Query times exceed 10 seconds on large tables.
resolution: Added composite index on (project_id, status, assignee_id) on the issues table. Query time reduced to under 50ms.

title: Migration script fails when column default value contains quotes
description: The database migration script crashes when a column has a default value containing single quotes. The migration generator does not escape special characters in default value strings, resulting in a SQL syntax error.
resolution: Updated migration generator to properly escape single quotes in default value strings.

title: Read replica lag causes stale data to appear after writes
description: After a write operation, reading data immediately from the read replica returns the old value because the replication lag is up to 5 seconds. The application does not route post-write reads to the primary database.

title: Deadlock detected on concurrent issue update operations
description: Under concurrent load, deadlocks occur when two transactions attempt to update the same issue row in different orders. The application does not handle the deadlock exception and returns a 500 error to the user.

title: Soft-deleted records appear in API responses
description: Records that have been soft-deleted (deleted_at is not null) are being returned in API list responses. The global soft-delete filter is not applied to queries in several repository methods that were recently added.

title: Database backup job silently fails on weekends
description: The nightly database backup job fails on Saturday and Sunday without generating any alerts. The failure is caused by a cron scheduling conflict with the weekend maintenance window that suspends write operations.

title: Full-text search index becomes corrupt after bulk delete
description: Performing a bulk deletion of more than 1000 records via the admin panel causes the full-text search index to become corrupted. Subsequent searches return errors until the index is manually rebuilt.

title: N+1 query problem in issue comment loading
description: Loading the issue detail page with comments triggers an N+1 query problem where one query is executed per comment to fetch the author's user record. For issues with 100 comments, this results in 101 database queries per page load.

title: Transaction isolation level set too low causes phantom reads
description: The database transaction isolation level is set to READ COMMITTED, which allows phantom reads in reporting transactions. Long-running reports may return inconsistent counts when concurrent inserts occur during the query.

title: Rate limiting headers missing from API responses
description: The REST API does not return X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, or X-RateLimit-Reset headers in responses. API clients cannot implement proper backoff strategies without this information.

title: Bulk create endpoint returns 200 when some items fail
description: When using the bulk issue creation endpoint, if some records fail validation while others succeed, the API returns HTTP 200 with partial success. The response should use HTTP 207 Multi-Status to indicate mixed results.

title: API returns 500 instead of 400 for malformed JSON payloads
description: When a client sends a request with a malformed JSON body, the API returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error instead of HTTP 400 Bad Request. The JSON parse exception is not being caught and handled at the middleware layer.
resolution: Added global exception handler for JsonParseException to return HTTP 400 with a descriptive error message.

title: Webhook payloads not delivered when target URL returns 301
description: Webhooks configured with target URLs that return a 301 Moved Permanently redirect are not followed. The webhook delivery service does not handle HTTP redirects and marks the delivery as failed.

title: GraphQL query depth limit not enforced
description: The GraphQL API does not enforce a query depth limit. Malicious or poorly written clients can send deeply nested queries that cause excessive database load and degrade performance for all users.

title: API versioning breaks backward compatibility for deprecated fields
description: The v2 API removes fields that were deprecated in v1 without a proper sunset period. Existing API clients using the v1 deprecated fields receive empty responses without a meaningful migration warning.

title: CORS headers not set for cross-origin requests from mobile apps
description: The API does not include Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers for requests from the mobile app's domain. This blocks the mobile web view from making API calls and causes authentication failures in the embedded browser.
resolution: Added mobile app domain to the CORS allowed origins list and deployed updated CORS configuration.

title: Pagination cursor becomes invalid after record deletion
description: When using cursor-based pagination and records are deleted between page requests, the pagination cursor becomes invalid. The API returns a 400 error instead of gracefully handling the missing cursor anchor record.

title: File upload endpoint accepts files exceeding size limit
description: The file upload endpoint does not enforce the documented 10MB file size limit. Files larger than 10MB are accepted and processed, consuming excessive server resources and potentially causing out-of-disk errors.

title: API documentation shows incorrect parameter types for filter fields
description: The OpenAPI specification documents several filter parameters as integer types, but the actual implementation accepts and requires string values. API clients generated from the spec fail to call these endpoints correctly.
resolution: Corrected parameter types in OpenAPI specification and regenerated client SDK documentation.

title: Push notifications not received on iOS 17 devices
description: Users on iOS 17 devices are not receiving push notifications for issue assignments and mentions. The device token registration is failing silently due to a change in the APNs authentication token format in iOS 17.

title: App crashes on Android when camera permission is denied
description: On Android devices, if the user denies camera permission when prompted during profile photo upload, the application crashes with a NullPointerException instead of displaying a graceful permission denied message.

title: Offline mode does not sync changes when connection is restored
description: Changes made while the mobile app is in offline mode are not synced to the server when the internet connection is restored. The sync queue is cleared on app restart, causing data loss for offline edits.

title: Touch gesture for swipe-to-dismiss conflicts with scroll
description: On mobile devices, the swipe-to-dismiss gesture on list items conflicts with the vertical scroll gesture. Users frequently trigger the dismiss action when attempting to scroll down the list, causing unintended item deletions.

title: Mobile navigation menu will not close after link tap
description: On iOS and Android, tapping a navigation link in the hamburger menu opens the target page but the menu overlay remains visible. Users must tap the hamburger icon again to close it, obscuring the page content.

title: Biometric authentication falls back to PIN without user prompt
description: When biometric authentication fails (e.g., wrong fingerprint), the app silently falls back to PIN authentication without informing the user. Users are confused by the unexpected PIN prompt.

title: App background refresh drains battery on low-power mode
description: The mobile app's background refresh feature continues to poll the server at full frequency even when the device is in low-power mode. This causes significant battery drain and degrades device performance.

title: Deep link URLs open the wrong screen on Android
description: Deep links for specific issue detail pages open the app home screen instead of the correct issue detail screen on Android. The intent filter in the Android manifest is not correctly configured to handle the URL scheme.

title: Hamburger menu overlay does not dismiss after selecting a page
description: In the mobile app, after the user selects a menu item from the side navigation drawer, the navigation drawer remains open on top of the newly loaded page. The drawer must be manually closed by swiping or tapping outside it.

title: App freezes when switching between tabs rapidly
description: Switching between the main navigation tabs faster than approximately once per second causes the mobile app to freeze for 3-5 seconds. The tab transition animation is blocking the main thread during data fetch operations.

title: Avatar image is missing in profile
description: User profile pages are not displaying the user's avatar image. Instead, a broken image icon is shown. The image URL stored in the database points to the old CDN endpoint which has been decommissioned.

title: Mobile navigation menu will not close
description: On mobile browsers, the hamburger navigation menu opens correctly but cannot be closed by tapping the close icon or tapping outside the menu area. Users are forced to reload the page to close it.
